end.summary:
Placed BCE to the left of 1 CE and CE to the right on a timeline.
Initially ordered BCE years incorrectly, then corrected the order by noting that BCE years count down toward 1 BCE.
Practised ordering 3000 BCE, 500 BCE, 100 CE, and 1947 CE.
Discussed that one historical source may have limits; this point remained mixed up at the end.
Teach-back was not passed.
end.parentNote: Asha practised placing BCE and CE dates on a timeline and used the rule that BCE years count down toward 1 BCE. Aarav corrected the BCE ordering later in the lesson, including the sequence 3000 BCE, 500 BCE, 100 CE, and 1947 CE. They still mixed up whether one source can tell the whole truth; at home, ask them to compare two short accounts of the same event and note what each source may leave out.
